title: [QM] Destination bin code is now visible and usable for the user
summary: Quality Management now allows users to select and use destination bin codes when creating manual transfer orders, with bin selection validated for bin-mandatory locations.
key_points: Destination bin code field added to manual Create Transfer Order action in Quality Management
Bin selection enabled only for bin-mandatory, non-directed locations
Selected bin code is validated against the destination location
Destination bin code propagates to the transfer order line
New permission set QltyMgmtBinView controls access to bin code visibility
quote: Add destination bin selection to the manual Create Transfer Order action in Quality Management.
